description: This file defines a React functional component named ViewDetailsModal which renders a modal dialog displaying detailed JSON data. The component formats keys and values for display, handles special formatting for user cost-related data, and leverages utility functions for currency and label formatting.

methods.name: ViewDetailsModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal displaying detailed key-value pairs from provided data, with special formatting for certain keys.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Helper function to convert data values into displayable strings or JSX, with custom rendering for user cost keys.

methods.name: toNumberLike
methods.description: Converts a value to a numeric representation of USD using parseUsdToNumber utility.

methods.name: isUserCostKeyLoose
methods.description: Checks if a key string loosely matches patterns indicating user cost data.
